heading: Agent observability
description: Send Codex, Claude Code and native OpenCode execution data to your observability service.
permissionRequired: Manage connections permission is required to configure agent observability.
otlpBaseUrlHint: Use the base URL without /v1/logs or /v1/traces. It must be reachable from each agent environment.
credentialsHint: The agent harness receives these credentials. Use a key limited to telemetry ingestion.
enableExportHint: Applies to executions that start preparation after saving.
contentCaptureHint: Native limits apply. Exported records can contain task content, including prompts and tool output. A collector can forward records to multiple services.
conflict: Another administrator changed these settings. Reload the saved settings to continue.
updateFailed: The observability settings could not be updated.
loadFailed: Agent observability settings could not be loaded.
refreshFailed: Saved settings could not be refreshed. Your draft is unchanged.
